rate_limit_buckets_scope_reference_valid.name: rate_limit_buckets_scope_reference_valid
rate_limit_buckets_scope_reference_valid.value:
(
        ("rate_limit_buckets"."scope" = 'actor' AND "rate_limit_buckets"."actor_user_id" = "rate_limit_buckets"."scope_key" AND "rate_limit_buckets"."workspace_id" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("rate_limit_buckets"."scope" = 'workspace' AND "rate_limit_buckets"."workspace_id" = "rate_limit_buckets"."scope_key" AND "rate_limit_buckets"."actor_user_id" IS NULL)
      )

workspace_invitations_active_workspace_e.name: workspace_invitations_active_workspace_email_unique
workspace_invitations_active_workspace_e.where: "workspace_invitations"."kind" = 'workspace' AND "workspace_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL

workspace_invitations_active_project_ema.name: workspace_invitations_active_project_email_unique
workspace_invitations_active_project_ema.where: "workspace_invitations"."kind" = 'project' AND "workspace_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NULL

workspace_invitations_kind_roles_valid.name: workspace_invitations_kind_roles_valid
workspace_invitations_kind_roles_valid.value:
(
        (
          "workspace_invitations"."kind" = 'workspace'
          AND "workspace_invitations"."workspace_role" IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            ("workspace_invitations"."project_id" IS NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."board_role" IS NULL)
            OR ("workspace_invitations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."board_role" IS NOT NULL)
          )
        )
        OR
        (
          "workspace_invitations"."kind" = 'project'
          AND "workspace_invitations"."workspace_role" IS NULL
          AND "workspace_invitations"."project_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "workspace_invitations"."board_role" IS NOT NULL
        )
      )

workspace_invitations_lifecycle_valid.name: workspace_invitations_lifecycle_valid
workspace_invitations_lifecycle_valid.value: NOT ("workspace_invitations"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "workspace_invitations"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
